summary: Complete frontend testing of redesigned Brightluxx homepage. All 10 features tested and verified working correctly. Homepage redesign successful with new typography rules, clean hero section, minimal stats section, and new Product Families showcase.

features_tested.feature: Homepage hero section loads with video player, headline 'Engineered for Brilliance'
features_tested.details: Hero section found with data-testid='hero-section', video player with data-testid='hero-video-player', headline 'Engineered for Brilliance' in title case, body text in sentence case

features_tested.feature: Stats section displays 4 stats with cyan gradient numbers
features_tested.details: Stats section displays: Screens Installed (1,500+), Satisfied Clients (42+), Projects Completed (56+), SQM LED Installed (840). Numbers use cyan gradient. Section is minimal without card borders.

features_tested.feature: Product Families section shows all 5 families with correct colors
features_tested.details: All 5 families present: LumiMorph (cyan), NaturaTex (emerald), SignaTouch (amber), GlassMorph (violet), PixelVue (rose). Each has image, icon badge, tagline (uppercase), name, description (sentence case), and Explore CTA

features_tested.feature: Each product family card has required elements and links correctly
features_tested.details: Verified LumiMorph card click navigates to /lumimorph. All cards have: image with gradient overlay, icon badge with brand color, tagline in uppercase, name, description in sentence case, Explore CTA

Section displays 4 categories: COB MicroLED (Ultra-fine P0.4-P1.2 pitch), Transparent LED (See-through displays), Outdoor LED (Weatherproof P4-P10), Creative & Custom (Curved & custom shapes). Each with icon, title, description, Explore CTA

features_tested.feature: Why Brightluxx section displays 4 advantage cards
features_tested.details: Section found with 'The Brightluxx Advantage' title. Shows 4 cards: Direct Factory, Gulf-Grade Stock, Fast Delivery, CPD Training (content from API differs slightly from code defaults)

features_tested.feature: CTA section has 'Start Your Project' and 'Screen Calculator' buttons
features_tested.details: 'Start Your Project' button links to /contact (verified via click test). 'Screen Calculator' button links to /calculator. Section has 'Let's Build Something Brilliant Together' headline with gradient text

features_tested.feature: Typography: headings in title case, body in sentence case, only small labels uppercase
features_tested.details: Body text-transform verified as 'none' (sentence case). Found 22 elements with .uppercase class for eyebrow labels. Global uppercase removed from index.css. Eyebrow labels like 'PREMIUM LED DISPLAYS — SINCE 2005', 'OUR COLLECTIONS', 'BY TECHNOLOGY' correctly uppercase

features_tested.feature: Navigation logo is properly sized and not clipped
features_tested.details: Logo dimensions: 220.9px x 40.0px. Height is within expected range (36-44px as per h-9/h-10 classes). Width is adequate, logo not clipped

features_tested.feature: All CTAs and links work correctly
features_tested.details: Verified: LumiMorph card → /lumimorph, Hero 'Get a Quote' CTA → /contact, COB MicroLED category → /products?category=cob-microled. All navigation working correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Hero title says 'Engineered for Brilliance' but code default says 'Engineering Brilliance' - content may be from API override, both variations are acceptable
Stats section values animate from 0 to final value (1500+, 500+, 800+, 12000m²) but show different values at different times due to animation and API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage redesign complete with: 1) Clean hero with video player, no floating icons, 2) Minimal stats section without card borders, 3) New Product Families showcase with 5 families (LumiMorph, NaturaTex, SignaTouch, GlassMorph, PixelVue), 4) Product Categories 'By Technology' section with 4 categories, 5) Why Brightluxx advantage section, 6) CTA section with contact and calculator buttons. Typography uses sentence case for body text, uppercase only for eyebrow labels. Logo properly sized at 40px height.
